info.name: SyncUp API - Private B2B SaaS Platform
info.description:
# SyncUp REST API Collection (NestJS 10 + Prisma + PostgreSQL)

Comprehensive, production-grade Postman collection covering all 40 endpoints across 8 core modules.

---

### 🚀 Quick Start Guide
1. **Import:** Import this file (`SyncUp_API.postman_collection.json`) into Postman.
2. **Authenticate:** Open **01. Authentication** folder and click **Send** on either:
   - **1.1 Login - Platform Owner** (Super Admin privileges: `aabdelfatah732@gmail.com`)
   - **1.2 Login - Libro Admin** (Organization Admin privileges: `zghabour@gmail.com`)
   - **1.3 Login - Dipdux Admin** (Organization Admin privileges: `sara@dipdux.com`)
3. **Automated Variables:** The test scripts automatically extract:
   - `{{access_token}}` (injected into Bearer Authorization for all requests)
   - `{{refresh_token}}`
   - `{{orgId}}` (active organization ID)
   - `{{userId}}`
4. **Subsequent Actions:** When you create a Project, Task, Channel, or Message, the newly generated IDs (`{{projectId}}`, `{{taskId}}`, `{{channelId}}`, `{{messageId}}`) are automatically saved to your collection variables!
